title: Jobbland.se Scraper
description: Scrape structured job listings from Jobbland.se. Provide a Jobbland search URL or use keyword and location.

url.title: Jobbland URL
url.description: A Jobbland search URL, for example a general, city, category, profession, company, or paginated URL.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search keyword used when no URL is provided.

location.title: Location
location.description: City or area slug, for example Stockholm, Goteborg, Malmo, or Uppsala.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of jobs to collect.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap for API result pages. Jobbland returns up to 30 jobs per page.

includeDescriptions.title: Include descriptions
includeDescriptions.description: Include full job description HTML and plain text when available.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. The actor works without a proxy in normal conditions.
